answer: Locks are published in raven, expire in prism, and bridge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 176 aliases as a result needs 28 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1206 identities would post 1341 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
